theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: Stocks Slump as Wall Street Gets AI Wake-Up Call: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Wall Street got a reality check as a bruising selloff in technology shares fueled concern the artificial-intelligence frenzy that has powered the equity bull market might be overblown.

top_news.title: Chocolate Price Spook Families for Halloween
top_news.summary: Halloween candy is getting more expensive as higher labor, energy and transportation costs continue to pressure food prices. Stew Leonard Jr., CEO of Stew Leonard’s, says bags of popular candy are up about 50 cents from last year, prompting some shoppers to trade down to cheaper options. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss how affordability is changing consumer behavior, and how both environmental and economic changes are impacting the business. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Crypto Hack Reignites Regulatory Debate
top_news.summary: A $6 billion crypto hack is putting digital-asset security back in the spotlight. Former CFTC chairman J. Christopher Giancarlo, known as “CryptoDad”, argues the attack exposed vulnerabilities at an individual firm rather than a failure of underlying blockchain technology. He is also calling for the US to take a more aggressive approach to state-sponsored cyberattacks. top_news.title: Lonnie Ali & Marc Rosen on New Muhammad Ali Amazon Show
top_news.summary: Lonnie Ali, Muhammad Ali's wife & Executive Producer of The Greatest, joins Marc Rosen of Authentic Brands to discuss the first authorized scripted series to take a more intimate look at Muhammad Ali beyond his boxing career. The two speak with Romaine Bostick on "The Close" on October 29, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: PacSun CEO: Brands Mean a Lot to Young People Today
top_news.summary: Brieane Olson, CEO of PacSun, says that the retailer’s core customer is 16 to 24, while it is also tracking differences between Gen Z and Gen Alpha. Drawing on a PacSun Youth Report conducted with GlobalData and surveying 6,000 young people, Olson said mental health ranks as their top priority. She cited PACSUN’s ongoing partnership with Selena Gomez and the Rare Impact Foundation as an example of collaborations intended to have lasting value for young customers. She speaks with Romaine Bostick

top_news.title: Burger King US President on Sales Turnaround
top_news.summary: Burger King US and Canada President Tom Curtis discussed the chain’s comparable-sales growth, cited in the conversation as 8.4%, against an estimate of 6.2%. Curtis said growth is being driven largely by customers who had stopped visiting and are now returning, drawn by a renewed connection to the brand. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Investor Looks to Bid on Club Pilates-Owner Xponential
top_news.summary: Fund 1 Investments LLC, the third-largest shareholder in Xponential Fitness Inc., the owner of Club Pilates and Pure Barre brands, said it’s pushing for a take-private and is looking to buy the company itself.

top_news.title: Rich Steinmeier on a Career in Management
top_news.summary:
Barry speaks with Rich Steinmeier, CEO of LPL Financial. They discuss his early career learnings at McKinsey. They also discuss LPL's $2.7 billion acquisition of Commonwealth, and the evolving relationship of AI and financial advice.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: The Future of Financial Advice: Masters in Business with Rich Steinmeier
top_news.summary: Barry speaks with Rich Steinmeier, CEO of LPL Financial. They discuss his early career learnings at McKinsey. They also discuss LPL's $2.7 billion acquisition of Commonwealth, and the evolving relationship of AI and financial advice. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Brazil Summons Argentine Envoy Over Role in Bolsonaro’s Escape
top_news.summary: Brazilian authorities summoned Argentina’s top envoy in the country on Friday to explain President Javier Milei’s role in helping Flávio Bolsonaro flee Brazil following his election defeat.
